title: sibling_worktree tests fail on Windows when TEMP is a long path: git init writes .git/hooks sample files past 260 characters
outcome: sibling_worktree tests fail on Windows when TEMP is a long path: git init writes .git/hooks sample files past 260 characters
acceptance: The sibling_worktree fixture tests pass on Windows when TEMP points at a repo-local scratch directory deep enough that default git init hook samples would exceed 260 characters; a test or fixture change shows it (for example fixtures created without hook samples).
No test depends on the length of the TEMP path for correctness, and fixture scratch stays inside the repository's scratch area.
